from pathlib import Path

CONFIG_PATH = Path("/etc/myapp/defaults.json")

def analyze_pdf(_pdf_path: str):
    data = CONFIG_PATH.read_bytes()
    return len(data)

def main(pdfs):
    reports = []
    for pdf in pdfs:
        reports.append(analyze_pdf(pdf))
    return reports
